```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: 9.0.x

      - name: Run Code Review
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const { execSync } = require('child_process');
            // This is a placeholder for the actual code review logic
            // In practice, you would integrate with a code review service
            console.log('Code review would run here with TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=true');
```
